calibration_sources: Qwen2.5-VL & InternVL-2.5 (Native Dynamic Resolution NaViT + 2D-RoPE + 2x2 Pixel-Shuffle MLP Merger)
FastV (An Image is Worth 1/2 Tokens After Layer 2) & VisionZip (Dominant + Contextual Visual Token Compression)
LLaVA-NeXT AnyRes High-Resolution Tiling & DocVQA / ChartQA / ScreenSpot Token Scaling Studies

workload.input_resolution: High-Resolution 2560x1440 Enterprise Document / UI Screenshot / Engineering Blueprint (4-Image Multi-Turn Session)
workload.model_and_hardware: 72B FP8 Vision-Language Model (ViT-600M + 72B LLM) on 4x H100 SXM5 GPUs
workload.benchmark_suite: Fine-Grained High-Res Visual QA Macro-Average (DocVQA, ChartQA, InfoVQA, TextVQA, ScreenSpot)

tiers.name: Tier 1: 固定 336×336 缩略图插值缩放 (初代 LLaVA-1.5 -> 仅 576 词极快，但小字模糊致准确率跌至 44.5%)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Fixed 336x336 Thumbnail Downsampling (576 Tokens · Blurs Text -> 44.5% Accuracy)
tiers.resolution_and_compression_stack: Squashes 2560x1440 image into a single 336x336 ViT grid (24x24 = 576 tokens)
tiers.spatial_and_text_fidelity: Destroys <12pt text legibility and aspect ratio; fails on dense financial tables & UI icons
tiers.recommended_for: Coarse natural-image classification or captioning where text reading is never required.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 高分辨率无压缩 AnyRes 4×4 网格切片 (单图狂塞 9,216 视觉词 -> TTFT 暴涨至 1,680ms)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Uncompressed AnyRes 4x4 Grid Tiling (9,216 Tokens/Img -> 1,680ms TTFT)
tiers.resolution_and_compression_stack: Crops image into up to 16x 336x336 tiles without spatial token merging (16 x 576 = 9,216 tokens)
tiers.spatial_and_text_fidelity: Restores 89.2% fine-grained accuracy, but 9,216 tokens/image triggers quadratic LLM prefill stalls
tiers.recommended_for: Early high-res VLM prototypes lacking spatial Pixel-Shuffle or token pruning.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 原生动态分辨率 NaViT + 2×2 Pixel-Shuffle 空间折叠 (Qwen2.5-VL / InternVL-2.5 -> 压缩 4x 至 2,304 词)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Native Dynamic Resolution NaViT + 2x2 Pixel-Shuffle Merger (2,304 Tokens · 90.4% Acc)
tiers.resolution_and_compression_stack: 2D-RoPE native aspect-ratio ViT + 2x2 adjacent patch channel concatenation & MLP projection (4x reduction)
tiers.spatial_and_text_fidelity: Eliminates tile-boundary seam slicing (90.4% accuracy) while cutting visual tokens 4x to 2,304
tiers.recommended_for: Standard single-image high-res OCR and document QA where all image regions must remain in KV cache.

tiers.name: Tier 4: NaViT 2×2 折叠 + 第2层跨模态注意力动态剪枝 (FastV/VisionZip -> 剔除 70% 空白背景，压至 720 词)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: NaViT 2x2 Pixel-Shuffle + Text-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning (720 Tokens · 90.1% Acc)
tiers.resolution_and_compression_stack: 2x2 Pixel-Shuffle (2,304 tok) -> Layer-2 cross-modal attention + dominant key merger prunes 70% background -> 720 tok
tiers.spatial_and_text_fidelity: Drops white margins/wallpaper while keeping 100% of query-relevant text/chart patches (12.8x total compression)
tiers.recommended_for: Production high-res multi-image VLM, video frame understanding, and UI agents requiring 195ms TTFT and 90.1% accuracy.
